run_kmeans_clustering: run k-means clustering on embedding data using faiss and save centroids and nearest assignments
compute_centroids: compute faiss k-means centroids from embedding data with configurable cluster count and iterations
convert_faiss_index_to_gpu: convert a faiss k-means cpu index to a gpu index for accelerated clustering
run_clustering_via_slurm: submit a faiss k-means clustering job to slurm via submitit with configurable gpu and cpu resources
load_and_search_centroids: load saved faiss k-means index and find nearest centroid for each data point with l2 distance
